hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && case "$FILE" in */bun.lock|*/build/*|*/.wxt/*|*/node_modules/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Generated file — do not edit directly"}}';; esac
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && case "$FILE" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) bunx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; esac; true
